content: 1. Doxepin metabolism is influenced by hepatic enzyme CYP2D6. Exercise caution and monitor closely when prescribing. Antidepressants should be carefully titrated to achieve the desired therapeutic effect, starting with the lowest feasible dose and monitoring for response. 2. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of doxepin by mechanisms other than CYP2D6. Use caution and monitor closely. Adjust the dose of the antidepressant carefully to achieve the desired effect, starting with the lowest feasible dose and monitoring its response during coadministration with tricyclic antidepressants (TCAs) and cobicistat. 3. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of doxepin cream by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely. Similarly, cobicistat increases the levels or effects of doxepin cream via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 4. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of doxorubicin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is serious, and alternative drugs should be considered. Cobicistat also increases the levels or effects of doxorubicin via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 5. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of liposomal doxorubicin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is serious, and alternative drugs should be considered. Cobicistat also increases the levels or effects of liposomal doxorubicin via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 6. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Cobicistat also increases the levels or effects of dronabinol via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Dronabinol is a CYP3A4 substrate. 7. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of dronedarone by mechanisms other than CYP3A4. This interaction is contraindicated. Dronedarone is both a CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inhibitor/substrate, while cobicistat is an inhibitor and substrate of CYP3A4 and CYP2D6. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of dronedarone via CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is contraindicated. 8. Dronedarone increases the levels or effects of darunavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 9. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of drospirenone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Significant changes in estrogen plasma levels may occur, potentially reducing the efficacy of hormonal contraceptives. 10. Drospirenone increases the levels or effects of darunavir and cobicistat by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 11. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of dutasteride by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 12. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of duvelisib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors increases duvelisib exposure, potentially increasing the risk of toxicities. 13. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of edoxaban by inhibiting P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Dose adjustments may be required with strong P-gp inhibitors. 14. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of edoxaban by inhibiting P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Dose adjustments may be required with strong P-gp inhibitors. 15. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of efavirenz by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely. Darunavir and efavirenz both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. 16. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of darunavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Co-administration may result in loss of therapeutic effect and development of resistance to darunavir. 17. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of cobicistat by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 18. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of efavirenz by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 19. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of elacestrant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is serious, and alternative drugs should be considered. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of elacestrant via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 20. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of elagolix by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Co-administration of elagolix 200 mg BID with strong CYP3A inhibitors for more than one month is not recommended. 21. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of elagolix by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Co-administration of elagolix 200 mg BID with strong CYP3A inhibitors for more than one month is not recommended. 22. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of darunavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Elagolix is a weak-to-moderate CYP3A4 inducer. 23. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of elbasvir/grazoprevir by mechanisms other than CYP3A4. This interaction is contraindicated. Cobicistat also increases the levels or effects of elbasvir/grazoprevir via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 24. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of eletriptan by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of eletriptan via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 25. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of eliglustat by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is contraindicated. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors are contraindicated with eliglustat in poor or intermediate metabolizers. 26. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of eliglustat by affecting CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 metabolism. This interaction is contraindicated. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors are contraindicated with eliglustat in poor or intermediate metabolizers. 27. Darunavir decreases the effects of elivaldogene autotemcel by mechanisms other than CYP3A4. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Patients should not take antiretroviral medications for at least one month before initiating stem cell mobilization therapy. 28. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is contraindicated. Co-administration with cobicistat increases duvelisib levels, potentially increasing the risk of toxicities. 29. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of encorafenib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If concomitant use of a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor is unavoidable, reduce the encorafenib dose to one-third of the original dose. 30. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of encorafenib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If concomitant use of a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor is unavoidable, reduce the encorafenib dose to one-third of the original dose. 31. Darunavir increases the toxicity of enfortumab vedotin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Enfortumab vedotin is an antibody-drug conjugate that releases monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE), which is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4. 32. Darunavir and enfuvirtide both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Use caution and monitor closely. 33. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of entrectinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid co-administration of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors with entrectinib, a CYP3A4 substrate. 34. Enzalutamide decreases the levels or effects of cobicistat by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is serious, and alternative drugs should be considered. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of enzalutamide via CYP3A4 metabolism. 35. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of eplerenone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is contraindicated. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of eplerenone via CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 36. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of erdafitinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, monitor closely for adverse reactions and consider dose adjustments. 37. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of ergot alkaloids by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is contraindicated.
